title: Open a lesson with a starter project
description:
As the student, I want to open a lesson and get its starter code in the IDE.

Feature: Lessons
  Scenario: Open lesson 1
    Given a lesson with a markdown description and a starter project
    When the student opens the lesson
    Then the description is shown beside the editor
    And the starter files are loaded
right_now_summary: The lesson shows its description and loads the starter files in the editor.
